scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @aka/shared build && concurrently --kill-others --success first --names shared,api,web "pnpm --filter @aka/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @aka/api dev" "pnpm --filter @aka/web dev"
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings 0 && prettier --check apps packages scripts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
